reels.title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the highest performing category (Multimodal/Diffusion: 2.0x). The concept of 'skip connections' in neural networks is highly visualizable, turning a rigid, static structure into a fluid, responsive highway.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do AI models sometimes 'forget' what they just saw, and how can a simple shortcut fix it?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: The difference between a rigid train track and an 'express lane' highway that allows cars to skip traffic and reach the finish line faster.
